name: A grassland food web, Jena

citation.text: Hines, J., Giling, D. P., Rzanny, M., Voigt, W., Meyer, S. T., Weisser, W. W., Eisenhauer, N., & Ebeling, A. (2019). A meta-food web for invertebrate species collected in a European grassland. Ecology, 100(4), e02679; Mangal network 5013.

description: Spiders, ground beetles, bugs, rove beetles, woodlice and clovers from the meta-food web of the Jena Experiment's grassland plots in Germany: who eats whom among the thousand invertebrate species collected there, read for two dozen of the most connected.
